quote.text: Remember how long you’ve been putting this off, how many extensions the gods gave you, and you didn’t use them. At some point you have to recognize what world it is that you belong to; what power rules it and from what source you spring; that there is a limit to the time assigned to you, and if you don’t use it to free yourself it will be gone and will never return.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Reflect on the time spent nurturing your children and realize the impermanence of opportunity—the chance to guide their growth is precious and irreplaceable.
    • Take responsibility for your actions and decisions as a parent, using each moment to instill virtues and prepare them for the unavoidable challenges of life.
  • Leadership
    • Acknowledge that the role you hold comes with limited time to inspire and influence; recognize that procrastination does not only delay progress but also diminishes your leadership impact.
    • Empower yourself and others by making thoughtful, decisive actions—understanding that every decision reflects the finite nature of our time and calling.
  • Product Management
    • Understand that each project or product has a limited window for success; delaying vital decisions can lead to missed opportunities, similar to time wasted in life.
    • Embrace your role by prioritizing innovation and timely execution, thereby transforming challenges into opportunities and fostering growth in your team and market.
